name: PrimaryNav - Get Involved Merged
description: The simplified header menu with the Get involved dropdown pinned open. The top level now reads Events, Chapters, Communities, Content hub, About, Get involved: Events is a plain link instead of a dropdown holding only All events, and Membership is gone. Get involved holds Volunteer, Donate and Sponsorship together, so it is not a one-item dropdown, and Mission is two levels deep instead of three. Chapters still lands directly after Events. The panel is pinned by the isolation route, because a hover does not survive the screenshot on this route.
